MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  FEBRUARY 4, 2019

  A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by CHAIR
  MEDAWAR.

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIR MEDAWAR led those in attendance in the Pledge of Allegiance

  3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Edler, Carman, Medawar, Zigrang, Schachter, Yoo

  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Scott

  STAFF PRESENT:  Planning Director Wahba, Associate Planner Thom,
  and Administrative Assistant Corea

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES OF DECEMBER 3, 2018
  AS PRESENTED.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.

  5.  PLANNING COMMISSION REORGANIZATION

  Planning Director Wahba thanked CHAIR MEDAWAR and presented him with a plaque
  for his service. Planning Director Wahba introduced VICE CHAIR ZIGRANG as Chair
  and COMMISSIONER CARMAN as Vice Chair.

  6.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE

  7.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6-A

  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.

  8.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  NONE

  9.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-01-19; APPLICANT: MR. CHARLES SANS;
  LOCATION: 5177 WILLOW WOOD ROAD; A Neighborhood Compatibility Determination
  is requested for proposed one and two-story additions to a single-story residence. A
  Variance is requested to exceed the maximum lot coverage by more than 10%.
  Associate Planner Thom presented a summary of the staff report for Planning Application
  No.01-19.

Planning Commission Meeting  1
Minutes, February 4, 2019
   Associate Planner Thom stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission,
  open the public hearing; take public testimony; discuss the issues; close the public hearing;
  and, adopt Resolution No. PA-01-19 approving the project.

  CHAIR ZIGRANG opened the public hearing.

  Bruce Krause, Architect, 609, Deep Valley Drive, stated that he has worked closely with
  planning staff to provide a design which would be good for the owners, neighbors, and the
  city.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR, Mr. Krause stated that he
  intended to design a home that compliments the original home as well as the
  neighborhood. Planning Director Wahba added that this design is typical in this
  neighborhood.

  In response to a question by VICE CHAIR CARMAN, Associate Planner Thom stated that
  a resident came in to review the plan but there was no opposition received by staff for this
  project.

  CHAIR ZIGRANG closed the public hearing.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER EDLER
  to,
  ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. PA-01-19, APPROVING THE PROJECT.

  AYES:  Edler, Carman, Medawar, Zigrang, Schachter, Yoo
  NOES:
  ABSENT:  Scott
  ABSTAIN:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that there is a 20-day appeal period for this item.

  10.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  NONE

  11.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

  A.  COMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS

  The Planning Commission agreed on the following Committee Assignments:
  • Environmental Advisory Committee – COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER (primary)
  AND COMMISSIONER YOO (alternate)
  • Equestrian Committee – CHAIR ZIGRANG
  • Traffic and Safety Committee – COMISSIONER SCOTT

  B.  SOUTH BAY CITIES COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS 20TH ANNUAL GENERAL
  ASSEMBLY – THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 28, 2018

  Planning Director Wahba provided the commissioners with information on the upcoming
  SBCCOG General Assembly and confirmed that registration is required.

  12.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, DECEMBER 11, 2018

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, JANUARY 22, 2019

  C.  DRAFT PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, DECEMBER 17,
  2018

  COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

Planning Commission Meeting  2
Minutes, February 4, 2019
   RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 12A – 12C

  There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered

  13.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR ZIGRANG adjourned the meeting at 7:18 p.m. to the next Planning
  Commission meeting on March 4, 2019.

  Respectfully Submitted,

  ______________________________  _______________________
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant  Heidi Luce, City Clerk
